context: 100K (max-model-len 100000), fp8 KV cache, gpu-mem-util 0.88, MTP speculative decoding
headline: Re-run of the 2026-10-13 B70 row after enabling vLLM --reasoning-parser qwen3: the planning-leak that cost the old row its fib/json/constraints scores is gone, every objective check now passes unaided, and the model's thinking cost is finally measurable (76.3K of 99.1K completion tokens). Composite 9.8 vs 8.5 — the lift is the SERVER parsing the thinking channel, not a better model: the answers were already correct in the leak-era run.
facts: vLLM serve flags: added --reasoning-parser qwen3 (same pinned image vllm/vllm-openai-xpu@sha256:2050..., same model Qwen3.8-27B-GPTQ-Int4 sym G128 + MTP BF16 draft, same tuning). Verified live: chat responses now carry a separate 'reasoning' field with clean 'content'.

vendor 0x8086 + xe driver (card1 on this boot; DRM index flipped vs the October labels, same silicon) = the serving GPU; container ZE_AFFINITY_MASK=0; b70-monitor (xe hwmon) logged 50W idle -> 241W under this run's generations; card0 vendor 0x10de (RTX 3080 Ti) idle — NOT used
83.9 tok/s headline (fixed 1000-token budget); 55.0-73.1 tok/s decode across the other tests
Thinking (first measurable run for this stack)

76,251 reasoning / 22,882 content completion tokens = 77% thinking. Per game: breakout 37,344 thinking + 13,423 content; fractal 35,497 + 9,024. fib: 2,383 of 2,443 tokens were thinking; the 60-token content passed the harness exec check (fib(50)=12586269025)

fib exec-correct, json valid+typed, constraints 3/3 sentences — all auto-passed. The old row needed a manual review to rescue these same answers because the planning preamble leaked into content (harness counted 15 sentences where 3 existed).

breakout: single self-contained 729-line doc; fractal: single 510-line doc with 3 canvases. No multi-document habit this run — the old 'outline doc + full doc + trailing prose' was largely the leaked thinking. Play-tests: painted + animates + responds, 0 JS errors.

game tests switched from an 1800s hard wall-clock to an ACTIVITY WATCHDOG (abort at 300s total silence + x3-repeated-300-char loop guard): a slow-but-progressing generation is never cut off. Two delta attempts under the old cap were cut mid-stream at 1800s (server still generating at 44-58 tok/s at the moment of cutoff). Committed as bench-site 95aff10.

observations.text: This run resolves the open item on the 2026-10-13 row: 'the thinking-leak could likely be fixed with a reasoning-parser change... would probably lift fib/json/constraints materially.' It did: fib 5->10, json 5->10, constraints manual-rescued->auto 10.

77% of this model's output tokens are thinking; on the games that is ~10 minutes of planning per game at ~58 tok/s. Under the old wall-clock that collided with the cap; with the watchdog it is a measurable model property instead of a fake failure.
breakout needed the starved-retry nudge (first attempt thin content + heavy thinking); the nudged generation (13.4K content tokens) is the one kept and play-tested.

open: delta capacity limit: three attempts (final one 74 min under an activity watchdog) exhausted the model's 100K output window (~77% of tokens go to thinking on game tasks) without emitting a complete self-contained document. Recorded as partial (2 of 3 games). A completion here depends on sampling landing inside the window, not on harness patience.

Watchdog run's client died with a socket 'timed out' at the very end while server logs show generation active to the last minute — cause not fully pinned; moot for the verdict (a context-exhausted partial is unplayable regardless).

Old row (qwen3.8-27b-gptq-int4-b70-vllm, 8.5) is kept as the leak-era record; rows are comparable only knowing the ruler changed: 2026-10-13 = leak-era server + hard cap, this run = parser + watchdog.
